q: How do I estimate the carbon footprint of one spectacle frame?
title: Spectacle frame carbon footprint
short: Weigh the frame by material, usually acetate, injected plastic or metal, and apply a material factor per kilogram. Add the factory's electricity and fuel per frame, and packaging. For lenses, do the same separately, since glass and plastic lenses differ.
audience: Eyewear makers and optical retail chains

ul: Material weight: acetate, nylon, steel, titanium.
Factory energy divided by frames made.

p: ISO 14067 sets out how to build and report a product footprint; state the boundary, cradle to gate or wider.

senseible: Senseible turns your fuel, power and material invoices into a dated, sourced activity record, the starting point for a per-unit footprint.
